notes: Identity verified from the supplied canonical text: exact title Dominant, open nonverbal displays are attractive at zero-acquaintance; authors Tanya Vacharkulksemsuk, Emily Reit, Poruz Khambatta, Paul W Eastwick, Eli J Finkel and Dana R Carney; DOI 10.1073/pnas.1508932113; PNAS 113(15):4009–4014 (2016). This is a PMC primary research article parse (SOURCE https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4839399/), including main Results, embedded SI Materials and Methods, Discussion and references; not an abstract-only or secondary report. No source PDF was supplied. Locations below are canonical section labels; PDF page correspondence cannot be checked. The assigned study identifier is "3", but this primary report labels its studies 1, 2a and 2b. The broad description and page locators do not identify an outcome or critical test, or establish that "3" denotes 2b. Mapping by ordinal position is not justified. Study 2a tests romantic selection; Study 2b includes dominance/openness rating contrasts and mediation of matches. These are different outcomes/tests with different sample roles. No candidate can be promoted to the assigned target. Candidate evidence only, not extracted target values: Study 1 has 144 speed-dates involving 24 participants, no exclusions; logistic selection odds ratio 1.76, t(263)=6.35, P=0.01; romantic-attraction Table 1 coefficient b=0.52, P<0.01, distinct from mediation paths. Study 2a has explicit critical-test N=2,983 potential response observations after excluding 17 male responders from 3,000; chi-square(1,N=2,983)=8.21, P<0.01, odds ratio 1.27. Study 2b reports 853 recruited rating participants, not an explicit analytic N for the dominance contrast; dominance expansive vs. contractive t(424)=18.02, P<0.0001, group means/SDs printed; no N derived from df and no d calculated. Study 2b mediation explicitly uses 2,983 level-1 match observations nested within six targets, not 853 rating participants; indirect dominance CI (2.82,6.37) and openness CI (0.40,0.83), with separate gender analyses also reported. No printed d identified in these candidate results; retain the printed metrics without conversion. No group sum performed. All assigned fields remain null because row correspondence is unresolved. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
